reviews.review:
Hold your guns, hold your robotic arms and get ready for a blast!

First of all, i'm extremely surprised that not many people talk about this game, it is such an awesome roguelite game that will make your heart pumps while having fun kicking robot a**!

What is good?
- Visual is beautiful, it is beautiful the way it need to be with the shell shading.
- Gameplay is smooth like the performance, everything just run together like a smooth running machine. Haha get it? ......no?... okay...
- Guns are fun, upgrades are simple yet it feel different for builds each run. 
- Bosses are unique and take few deaths to learn (not apply on very first boss)
- Music is OH MY GOD HIT ME MORE

What is bad?
- Sniper dmg just didn't feel pleasureful, can be a bit higher to feel the "OH YEAH SNIPE YA"

Overall: This game is a must if you love roguelite with camp upgrade progression and beautiful shell shading visual. Can't wait for more updates!

its just pure fun. great weapons, great level generation, and highly replayable

Every update has been amazing since the very start

The game is fantastic. Its easily got some of the smoothest gameplay Ive ever experienced. Better than most AAA games I've played. It keeps momentum going as well as Warframe does and allows for nice precise movements for easy platforming. There are a lot of guns to choose from that randomly generate with perks and modifier, more of which seem start appearing as you beat the higher difficulties. Others have mentioned that there isnt a lot of content yet, I dont necessarily disagree with that but the combinations of character classes + class specific perks + weapon specific perks keeps me coming back over and over again. Ive been a roguelike fan for a long time and this one is a winner. Its worth the purchase price to me. Ive gotten a lot of hours out of it already and I want the developers to have funding to keep fleshing it out because what they've got is a really incredible foundation.
